CVE-2021-42521.title: There is a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in VTK before 9 ...
CVE-2021-42521.description: There is a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in VTK before 9.2.5, and it lies in IO/Infovis/vtkXMLTreeReader.cxx. The vendor didn't check the return value of libxml2 API 'xmlDocGetRootElement', and try to dereference it. It is unsafe as the return value can be NULL and that NULL pointer dereference may crash the application.

CVE-2025-57109.title: Kitware VTK (Visualization Toolkit) 9.5.0 is vulnerable to Heap U ...
CVE-2025-57109.description: Kitware VTK (Visualization Toolkit) 9.5.0 is vulnerable to Heap Use-After-Free in vtkGLTFImporter::ImportActors. When processing GLTF files with invalid scene node references, the application accesses string members of mesh objects that have been previously freed during actor import operations.

CVE-2026-9535.title: A out-of-bounds read vulnerability exists in the vtkChacoReader I ...
CVE-2026-9535.description: A out-of-bounds read vulnerability exists in the vtkChacoReader InputGraph2 functionality of vtk (version(s): 9.6.1). A specially crafted chaco can lead to an out-of-bounds read. An attacker can provide a malicious file to trigger this vulnerability.
